create_adaptive_softmax: create an AdaptiveSoftmax module with a vocab size, input dim, and cutoff buckets for efficient softmax
build_tied_head_module: build a TiedHeadModule that projects input through tied embedding weights and a class projection layer
adapt_target_for_cutoffs: adapt target tensor indices into cutoff bucket targets using the adapt_target method of AdaptiveSoftmax
compute_log_prob: compute full vocabulary log probabilities from hidden vectors using the get_log_prob method of AdaptiveSoftmax
create_tied_linear: create a TiedLinear layer that performs a linear transformation using shared weights with optional transpose
